label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee celebration for the mayor in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves replacing spoiled stock, eight lanterns, and a lighting-inspection pretext to bring the mayor in. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated; baker knowingly baked, kept the surprise confidential and advanced funds. Neighbour knowingly helped only with a private grain-credit enquiry, not demonstrably knowing the jubilee purpose. Secretary arranged the inspection escort but is not shown knowing its secret purpose. Mayor learned of the bread order and later jubilee bread, but was not told the actual surprise purpose; secrecy was therefore partial, not total.
